qa_pairs.question: In 2023, among the three dimensions of new consumption categories, concerns, and information sources of the Chinese pre - pregnancy population, is there an obvious correlation among the attention to nutrition - related content, health product consumption behavior, and trust in doctors?
qa_pairs.explanation: 88.7% of the pre - pregnancy population is concerned about 'Nutrition supplement' (chart_141_1), which is highly consistent with the 77.4% proportion of new consumption of pre - pregnancy health products (chart_141_4), indicating that the concept of paying attention to nutrition has been translated into actual purchasing behavior. Meanwhile, 77.0% of users trust doctors the most (chart_141_3), and doctors are usually the core source of nutrition - related advice and health product recommendations. A coherent path from trust - concern - consumption is formed among the three, so there is a correlation.

qa_pairs.question: Graphic and short - video are the two most preferred information forms for the pre - pregnancy population. But does this deviate from the types of platforms they actually access most frequently for pre - pregnancy products?
qa_pairs.explanation: Although 81.9% of users prefer graphics and 75.5% prefer short - videos (chart_141_2), the platform they actually access most frequently for pre - pregnancy products is the maternal and infant app (61.5%) (chart_141_5), while the contact proportion of short - video platforms (e.g., Douyin) is only 4.9%. This shows that although users prefer short - videos and graphics, when it comes to actually obtaining product information, they rely on professional apps with stronger functionality and more vertical content. There is an obvious deviation between preference and contact channels.

qa_pairs.question: In 2023, among the three dimensions of concerns, consumption categories, and information sources of the Chinese pre - pregnancy population, what are the options with the highest proportions respectively?
qa_pairs.answer: Concern about Nutrition supplement (88.7%), Pre - pregnancy check - up (78.5%), Doctors (77.0%)
qa_pairs.explanation: Among the concerns of the pre - pregnancy population, the option with the highest proportion is 'Nutrition supplement' (88.7%) (chart_141_1); among the new consumption categories, 'Pre - pregnancy check - up' ranks first (78.5%) (chart_141_4); among the trusted information sources, 'Doctors' are the most trusted (77.0%) (chart_141_3). These three represent the extreme values in the three dimensions of cognition and concern, actual consumption, and information acquisition respectively.

qa_pairs.question: Among the preconception population concerned about Nutrition supplement, what percentage also made new purchases of Pre - pregnancy health products? Round to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of those concerned about Nutrition supplement is 88.7% × The proportion of new consumption of Pre - pregnancy health products is 77.4% = 0.887 × 0.774 = 0.686538. Rounded to 2 decimal places, it is 68.65%.
